answer: Coordination canyon pricing: each agent’s influence on a shared decision is capped by the narrowest gap between its declared action and the median action of its declared cluster. Agents whose actions diverge from that cluster below a threshold pay a per-action whisper tax proportional to the divergence, settled in credits. To hold many identities, an attacker must keep each one inside a distinct cluster and pay that tax on every marginal action; spreading identities across the canyon multiplies the per-identity compliance cost.
